expected_solc_divergence.reason: Before '0.8.21' solc keeps the declaration of the true branch on a conditional, so `(b ? f : g).selector` is accepted and always evaluates to the selector of `f`, whatever `b` is. Slang implements the '0.8.21' semantics for every version: a conditional never names a declaration, so it also rejects this program on '0.8.0' to '0.8.20'.
